facility.name: Excel Pre-School
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Accredited,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 501 S MARSHALL ST, HENDERSON, TX, 75654

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The operation did not have a current employee list printed and posted during the inspection.     This was corrected at the inspection when the list was printed off and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The operation did not update/provide proof of coverage by their anniversary date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The operation did not update/provide proof of coverage by their anniversary date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: This standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance through an investigation when it was determined that infants were sleeping in restrictive devices on multiple occasions for extended times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: This standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance through an investigation when it was determined that caregivers were not following the written feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: This Minimum Standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance through an investigation when it was determined that a parent was not receiving a daily report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: This standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance through an investigation when the director stated another individual was responsible for the daily running of the facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The most recent inspection report from December 2025 was not posted at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: During the inspection bottle of fabric softener and laundry detergent were present in a room with children and within reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The most recent inspection report from May 2025 was not posted at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: This standard was found to be out of compliance through a DFPS investigation. The operation stated they did not have a record of who picked up the child
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: During the inspection a person with a Conditional background check was not following the conditions set on their background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the insepction a child was observed playing with a container of Gain Fabric Sheets marked keep out of reach
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual with a pending background check was in a classroom watching children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the insepction a child was found to be by themselves in a room with the lights off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: This standard was found to be out of compliance through an investigation, when a caregiver stated they had at one point did not inform a parent or the office of a less serious injury to their child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection an individual that did not have an eligible background check was present inside a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outline Daily Activities: During the walkthrough the activity plan was seen posted, the plan did not list the dates the plan covered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outline Daily Activities (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Exposed dry wall and peeling paint were observed during the walk through.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Update Admission Information - Procedure: During review the 8 children's records seen had not been updated since 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Update Admission Information - Procedure (26 TAC §746.609(a))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: During my inspection I observed infants sitting in restrictive devices for over 15 minutes. The children were not eating or being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feeding instructions were reviewed and had not been updated in more than 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: This Minimum Standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance. The operation has not updated or provided liability insurance information by the required date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The fire drill documentation was observed and discussed at the operation. The average exit time was seen to be 4 minutes during the fire drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: A current employee list was not available upon request.     This was corrected at the inspection when the staff made a current employees list.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: During the inspection a smoke detector was heard beeping for low battery. The monthly test log was then observed after and found ot not have been complete since January.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: During the inspection a sign in and sign out log was viewed however there were not parent or employee initials or signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: During the inspection I observed the infant caregivers using the handwashing sink to clean bottles, and the cleaning sink to wash their hands. The caregivers then switched back to using the handwashing sink for handwashing and vice versa.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: During the inspection the sign in and sign out log was viewed. The log does not have a time of the children's arrival or time of the children's departure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Your operation did not complete the employees who left survey for 2022 in the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection one of the classrooms was observed with 1 caregiver and 18 children, the specified age range of the classroom was 3 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: During the inspection only 7.5 hours of annual training could be provided for the director for the previous training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Time Period of Training: The operation was not using the caregivers hire date as the starting point for annual training.     This was corrected at the inspection when I discussed this with the person in charge, the operation will now start to use the hire date as the starting point for annual trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Time Period of Training (26 TAC §746.1313)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the inspection the flooring in multiple classrooms was observed to be loose or missing. This posed a tripping hazard to caregivers and children and exposed the material for children to pick at.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The current employee list was not posted or printed upon arrival for the inspection.    This was corrected at the inspection when the person in charge printed off a copy and posted it to the board.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection the two year old classroom was found to be out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: During the inspection 4 out of the 8 records observed did not have the required notarized affidavit. 3 did not have the employment start date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
